summary: Stamp controller-owned official evidence (tw-twse-tpex-official-market) with the requirement tenant (PANTHEON_TENANT_ID / PANTHEON_BFF_TENANT_ID) and maintain strict tenant isolation on reads (no public or untenanted fallback).

incident_context.symptom: In isolated L12 stack after bounded Taiwan pull, official run's latest_source_record had metadata.tenant_id None and GET /api/source-ingest/evidence/bundles with tenant-dev source_ingest_reader token returned only research suite's own bundle; training failed 'exactly one source evidence bundle must bind the selected connector run'.
incident_context.root_cause: Reconciled official connector and ingested SourceRecords/bundles lacked requirement tenant identity; read endpoints strictly enforce tenant isolation so untenanted records were invisible to tenant-scoped readers.
incident_context.resolution: Persona reconciler resolves requirement tenant from PANTHEON_TENANT_ID / PANTHEON_BFF_TENANT_ID and stamps desired state and connector metadata; pipeline and persist_source_evidence_refs stamp SourceRecords, evidence bundles, and evidence items with connector tenant; runtime readback includes tenant_id in provenance and metadata.

acceptance_verification.ac1_connector_and_records_stamped: passed: connectors provisioned by persona reconciler carry metadata.tenant_id set to the requirement tenant; IngestPipelineService and persist_source_evidence_refs stamp SourceRecord, evidence items, and evidence bundles with the connector's requirement tenant
acceptance_verification.ac2_strict_tenant_reads: passed: untenanted, mismatched-tenant, and anonymous reads of source records, bundles, and items fail closed (401/404); no public or untenanted fallback is added
acceptance_verification.ac3_admitted_tenant_read: passed: reader admitted for the requirement tenant (tenant-dev) reads tw_price_daily source records, evidence bundle, and evidence items; other tenants receive 404 or empty list
acceptance_verification.ac4_untenanted_paths_preserved: passed: ingest paths not driven by tenant-bearing requirement keep existing behavior; all 181 test_service, 52 reconciler, and 105 controller worker tests pass
acceptance_verification.ac5_test_coverage: passed: comprehensive unit and integration tests added in test_persona_source_reconciler.py, test_controller_worker.py, and test_service.py

local_verification.result: passed (52 reconciler tests, 105 controller worker tests, 181 service integration tests passed)
